_readme: Sample answer file for the interactive tasks in fleet-component-recovery-plan.json, consumed via Import-VCFIRAnswerFile.
Provide one answer set per cmdlet invocation. Both depot modes use four Get-BackupsFromSFTPServer answer sets in the same order: VCFMS, Log Management, VCF Automation, Telemetry.
Get-BackupsFromSFTPServer uses group 1 and Y to build the restore JSON. If you choose custom group 0 when offered, supply one backup point ID per component in the order prompted before the final Y/N.
Confirm-ManualStep is a flat list of pre-approved AnswerKey strings. Keep a key only if the work at that gate will be complete before the plan reaches it. Remove a key to wait for Enter at that gate.
Run each task interactively once first to see its real prompts/IDs, then transcribe your answers here in the same order.
Every key below is optional. Omit a cmdlet to answer at the console. A listed cmdlet fails if its answers run out or a supplied value is invalid.

The confirmations below correspond to two cluster-entry removals and two runtime deployments (VCFMS, then VCF Automation), one scale operation, and four restores (VCFMS, Log Management, VCF Automation, Telemetry).
